name: Set
cue: Lie face-down with arms extended overhead and legs straight.

name: Lift
cue: Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly, keeping your gaze down.

name: Reach long
cue: Reach through your fingers and toes with a small controlled lift.

name: Hold
cue: Hold briefly without tipping your head back.

name: Lower
cue: Lower your arms, chest and legs under control.

name: Reset
cue: Return to the mat before the next repetition.
